title: Cart
description: Shopping cart containing items a customer intends to purchase. Tracks cart contents, total value, currency, status, and timestamps for e-commerce checkout processes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping cart

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user or customer who owns this cart

items.description: Array of product identifiers or item names currently in the cart

total.description: Total price of all items in the cart including any applicable discounts

currency.description: ISO currency code for the cart total (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

status.description: Current status of the cart (e.g., active, abandoned, converted, expired)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was first created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was last modified
